statements.title: Lemma 3.1 · Identities
covered: Coefficient collapse, the three quotient derivatives and the Γ identity.
Existence, uniqueness and signs of f₁/β₁ zeros; monotonicity and uniqueness for α₁ and its even-period value.
missing: Simplicity of the α₁ zero and identification of K = 2E with a unique numerical modulus k₀ are not proved in this snapshot.
assumptions: Jacobi differential rules, initial/period data and positivity hypotheses are supplied through the Jacobi structures.

statements.title: Lemma 3.2 · Riccati slope bound
covered: The Riccati pair, z derivative, T₁T₂ product, common sign and AM–GM slope inequality.
The oriented phase-lift derivative bound on signed brackets.
missing: The displayed exact square-gap formula for |u′| − 1 and its equality-case characterization are not exported as matching theorems in this snapshot.
assumptions: Nonzero sn/dn and q/ℰ denominators, common sign and bracket conditions remain explicit in the theorem parameters.

statements.title: Lemma 3.3 · Crossing principle
covered: The counting clause is linked in the phase, counting, bracket and arc passages below.
missing: Analytic zero orders and finiteness of tangency phases are not proved by Crossing.crossing.
assumptions: CrossingData assumes continuity, endpoint values and strict branch monotonicity; the article derives these analytically.

statements.title: Theorem 3.4 · Exact first conjugate time
covered: Exactly one reduced-Jacobian zero in [p₀,p₁] and in (0,p₁]; positivity excludes zeros before p₀.
missing: Continuity and phase extrema of p* are explicitly outside the published Lean scope.
The geometric identification of conjugate/cut time and the scale t = 2kp are not certified by these scalar root-counting declarations.
assumptions: exact_first_time and first_time_complete require hfin: finite tangencies on the first bracket.
JacobiFull hypotheses; the reduced base is constructed by JacobiCore.toJacobiFull.

statements.title: Theorem 4.1 · Conjugate times in every cell
covered: One zero on each closed bracket, exhaustion of the half-open cell, two distinct roots for K ≠ 2E, bracket contact iff K = 2E and the necessary location of coincident roots.
The phase of an even-period zero and the cumulative 2N root count.
missing: Simplicity, interior tangency zero orders and the quartic order of the coincident root are not formalized.
The unique critical modulus k₀ is not identified; Lean uses the algebraic condition K = 2E.
assumptions: The counting declarations require finite tangencies on the left and right brackets (hL/hR or hfin).
Lean cell index m corresponds to article n = m + 1. JacobiFull is conditional data, not a construction of SE(2) geodesics.

statements.title: Remark 4.2 · Coincident zero order
missing: The quartic expansion and exact order four are not formalized in this snapshot. Cell-counting theorems do not establish this zero order.

statements.title: Theorem 5.1 · Floquet form and large-index law
missing: Both the Floquet determinant identity and the large-index asymptotic law are outside the published Lean scope (Appendix A excludes Section 5).

statements.title: Remark 5.2 · Late conjugate points are folds
missing: This is a claim from the companion manuscript, not a theorem of these fifteen Lean modules. No formal proof of the stated late-fold conclusion is indexed.

statements.title: Remark 5.3 · Separatrix limits
missing: The k → 1 limits and their rate are outside the published Lean scope.
